close_reason: Done partially in [commit]; followup bd:JMAP-6r7c.65 tracks the full builder. Added CustomCaTransport::from_pem_bytes addressing the highest-frequency operator-friction case (single PEM file). Multi-cert chains and mTLS need a builder API; filed separately to keep the bead atomic. PEM fixtures generated via openssl as independent oracle; round-trip test asserts byte-identical DER output. Minimal in-line PEM decoder avoids adding rustls_pemfile dep.
title: CustomCaTransport takes Vec<u8> DER bytes — no support for PEM, multi-cert chains, or trust store builder
